title: IRS Transcript Reported Income Leaderboard
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irs:transcript reported_income_usd=*
| stats sum(reported_income_usd) as total_value, avg(reported_income_usd) as avg_value by transcript_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks transcript type values by total and average reported income across IRS transcript events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `reported_income_usd` values for each IRS transcript event and review total and average reported income by transcript type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total reported income.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which transcript type shows the biggest reported income numbers in your IRS transcript data.
